entities.name: Aryl nitro reduction
observations: The reactant aryl nitro group [N+](=O)[O−] is converted to an aryl amine N in the product; the remaining scaffold is retained.
This is nitro-group reduction, not ring N-oxide reduction.

entities.name: Pd/C hydrogenation
observations: The closest exact precedent records palladium and carbon with ethyl acetate; Pd/C is consistent with catalytic nitro reduction.
An external hydrogen source such as H2 is commonly used but was not explicitly listed in the exact database record.
